layout_sources: https://pkg.go.dev/git.sr.ht/~mendelmaleh/pfin/parser/amex (Date, Description, Card Member, Account #, Amount, then the additional-details columns; MM/DD/YYYY; newest first)
https://github.com/keatz1/budget_tracker/blob/main/tests/fixtures/csv/amex.csv (shaped on a real export: padded descriptions, Account # like -21005)
https://lists.gnucash.org/pipermail/gnucash-user/2025-August/117158.html (one Amount column, charges positive, payments negative)
notes: Date,Description,Card Member,Account #,Amount (ticking "include all additional transaction details" adds Extended Details, Appears On Your Statement As, Address, City/State, Zip Code, Country, Reference, Category, with line breaks inside quoted cells). Charges positive, payments and credits negative, as Amex sees the account. Descriptions unquoted and padded with runs of spaces; Account # is a minus sign and the last five digits. Newest first, MM/DD/YYYY, no thousands separator, LF assumed. No balance in the file.
